summary: Widen the k grid past 51 (edge chosen in every fold) and rerun the pilot-only nested CV
reasoning: Observation step-14 contradicted the narrow grid (cv_auc 0.7857 < 0.80). The pilot-only diagnostic is strong: all five outer folds selected the grid's edge, k=51 with distance weights, so the true optimum likely lies beyond it. Fix: extend K_GRID to {3..151} including 71, 101, 151 — still tuning only k and its weighting as the route prescribes, decided from pilot folds alone. Same nested 5x5 CV, same seed. Expect the selected k to sit in the interior if ~0.151 is enough, with cv_auc reaching >= 0.80; kNN cost stays trivial (600 tiny fits, n_jobs=1, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1).
